DEFINE INSTRUMENT tas_instrument(
  double kI = 1.55,

  double A3 = 0,
  double A4 = 70,
  double L3 = 1.0,
  double L4 = 1.0,
  int Mono_flatswitch = 0
)

DECLARE
%{
  double m_n;
  double hbar;
  double meV_to_SI;
  double SI_to_meV;
  double MGUIDE;
  double W_para;
  double R0_para;
  double Qc_para;
  double alpha_para;
  double LGUIDE_1;
  double LGUIDE_2;
  double rho_AV;
  double L1;
  double L2;
  int SM;
  int SS;
  double DM;
  double DA;
  double A1;
  double A2;
  double RMH;
  double RMV;
  double A5;
  double A6;
  double RAH;
  double RAV;
  double lambdaI;
  double EI;
  double SelFreq;
  double dlambdaI;
  double l_min;
  double l_max;
  double e_min;
  double e_max;
  double beta_guide_1;
  double beta_guide_2;
  double s_guide_1;
  double s_guide_2;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  m_n = 1.67493e-27;
  hbar = 1.05457e-34;
  meV_to_SI = 1.6022e-22;
  SI_to_meV = 6.2414e+21;
  MGUIDE = 3.2;
  W_para = 0.0025;
  R0_para = 0.99;
  Qc_para = 0.0217;
  alpha_para = 3.9;
  LGUIDE_1 = 18.65;
  LGUIDE_2 = 17.8;
  rho_AV = 1.23;
  L1 = 1.75;
  L2 = 2.2;

  SM = -1;
  SS = +1;
  DM = 3.355;
  DA = 3.355;

  A1 = SM*RAD2DEG*asin(M_PI/(DM*kI));
  A2 = 2*A1;
  RMH = (L1+L2)/(2*sin(A1*DEG2RAD));
  if (Mono_flatswitch == 1) RMH = 0.0;
  RMV = (L1+L2)*sin(A1*DEG2RAD);

  A5 = SA*RAD2DEG*asin(M_PI/(DA*kF));
  A6 = 2*A5;
  RAH = (L3+L4)/(2*sin(A5*DEG2RAD));
  RAV = SA*1.0/rho_AV;

  lambdaI = 2*M_PI/kI;
  EI = SI_to_meV*hbar*hbar*kI*kI*1e20/2.0/m_n;
  SelFreq = 3956.06/(lambdaI*(360.0/(19.7+(2.1*tilt)))*0.25);
  dlambdaI = (1.75004E-05*pow(lambdaI,6) - 5.13903E-04*pow(lambdaI,5) + 6.04404E-03*pow(lambdaI,4) - 3.66989E-02*pow(lambdaI,3) + 1.22399E-01*pow(lambdaI,2) - 2.19626E-01*lambdaI + 2.0E-01)*lambdaI;
  l_min = lambdaI - dlambdaI;
  l_max = lambdaI + dlambdaI;
  e_min = 81.81/l_max/l_max;
  e_max = 81.81/l_min/l_min;

  beta_guide_1 = LGUIDE_1/2800.0*180.0/M_PI;
  beta_guide_2 = LGUIDE_2/2800.0*180.0/M_PI;
  s_guide_1 = 2800.0 - sqrt(2800.0*2800.0 - LGUIDE_1*LGUIDE_1);
  s_guide_2 = 2800.0 - sqrt(2800.0*2800.0 - LGUIDE_2*LGUIDE_2);
%}
